definitions.gloss: collection of haiku; anthology of haiku
definitions.explanation: A book collecting haiku, usually by one poet. The haiku counterpart of {歌集|かしゅう} (tanka collection) and {詩集|ししゅう} (poetry collection).

examples.japanese: {芭蕉|ばしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{句集|くしゅう}。
⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{句集|くしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To publish one's first haiku collection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{書|か}きためた⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{句集|くしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather gathered the haiku he had written over many years into a single collection.

notes:
⟦{句|く}→句：02137_ku⟧ (haiku, verse) + {集|しゅう} (collection).

- {句集|くしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to publish a haiku collection
- {句集|くしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧: to compile a haiku collection
